newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Analysts look for FTSE 100 correction.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Analysts look for FTSE 100 correction.

text.p: The FTSE 100 share index, up 13 points at 4,063.2 in early trade on Friday, needs to correct to below 4,000 to gather strength before renewing its challenge on record heights, technical analysts said.

"The pattern we just formed suggests some kind of correction and we would be looking for a drop to 3,990 points in the short term. But that would not be a negative signal and would give the market room for recovery," Julius de Kempanaer, analyst at Rotterdam's Institute for Research and Investment Services said. Analysts said the FTSE 100 had faltered in its run-up towards 4,100 and was looking a little fragile.

"The chart doesn't look too healthy. We spiked up and then faded towards 4,100. It all looked a bit half-hearted and we could do with a correction," a second analyst said, noting that Wall Street's abbreviated session today would dampen business.
De Kempanaer said the market was going nowhere until it smashed resistance around 4,090 and 4,100 points.
"If we manage to break that then the bull run can continue but for the time being I see the FTSE 100 trapped in a range between 3,900 and 4,100," de Kempenaer said.
